reviews.text: Akiko and Matteo provided excellent service. We were happy with all aspects of our visit.

Our table had an amazing experience tonight, and a big part of that was our incredible server, Karina. She was warm, attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our meal.

Our group of friends gets together once a month, and this time we decided to try somewhere different from our usual neighborhood spot. We're so glad we did! The food was great, but Karina's outstanding service truly made the evening special.

By the time we left, everyone at the table was talking about how wonderful she was. She made us feel welcome, took great care of us, and helped make our night one to remember. We will definitely be back and hope to see Karina again. Thank you for such a fantastic dining experience!

Celebrated my birthday here and reserved the patio for my party of ~40ppl. We had such a great time! Special thanks to Ben, Vico, and Sophie for taking care of us and accommodating all of our requests. My group was able to have separate bills and the team did a great job at keeping everything organized. Lovely team to communicate and plan with beforehand (shoutout Nicky!), the night couldn't have gone any better!!

I've been several times, and have always enjoyed the experience. I honestly cannot think of a time I didn't enjoy it.

As for staff, great. Typically very friendly and fun. (I say typically because everyone has off days, so no grudges on once or twice with shortness from service)

To note; Carolina was very personable as far as a bar tender, with solid recommendations. I actually promised to write this review a year ago because I loved her service, forgot, had her again and immediately remembered. (She did not ask for the record out of brazen humility)

Definitely worth checking out in Leaside.
Norah and Kaitlyn were fantastic and were very impressed with their service.
Norah and Kaitlyn were wonderful!!!!!!

Me and my bestie came to local to watch a fifa match, got placed upstairs on the rooftop bar, and the seats were perfect, right in front of the tv, food was great, our bartenders were so incredibly sweet, so shout out to Kaitlyn and Derka for making the experience so much better, very attentive, checking in on us every so often, overall we had such a great time and will be back!  🥹

My roommate and I came to Local Leaside to watch the FIFA World Cup and had the BEST time. We were up on the rooftop and the whole vibe was unreal. Huge shoutout to Kaitlyn S and Derka, their energy made the experience even better. They were so welcoming, fun, and really brought the atmosphere to life. Between the game, the crowd, and the service, everything was on point. Definitely one of those nights you don’t forget. Can’t wait to come back!

The food was great! Harrison was so welcoming, made great conversation and provided amazing service. Would definitely come again!

Great food! Exceptional service!! I have been to many, many restaurants and I can honestly say that the service provided by Paige and the team was absolutely amazing!!! The food and drinks were delicious. The only “hiccup” we had was a mix up in the kitchen and they made a mistake on one of our meals. Paige immediately addressed it and took full responsibility for the mistake (even thought I don’t think it was actually her fault). Between Paige and the managers they not only “made it right” they actually went above and beyond to make sure that we had a super positive experience. I look forward to enjoying many more meals here and hoping that Paige will be our server again. ❤️

Always amazing service and especially Paige and Hazmile working on Canada in 40 plus degrees! Kudos to the chefs also! All together 5 star experience always!
